verses.text: No! You are going to know.
Then, no! You are going to know.
No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...[2]
You will surely see the Hellfire.
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.[3]
Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.[4]

footnotes.1: i.e., remain in them temporarily, meaning until the Day of Resurrection.
footnotes.2: The conclusion of this verse is estimated to be "...you would not have been distracted from preparing for the Hereafter."
footnotes.4: i.e., the comforts of worldly life and whether you were grateful to Allāh for His blessings.
